scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter browser-client-example typecheck && bun run --filter client-promise-example typecheck && bun run --filter sdk-system-example typecheck && bun run --filter local-platform-example typecheck
scripts.python:sdk:test: python3 -m venv .venv-python && .venv-python/bin/python -m pip install -q -e packages/python && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=packages/python .venv-python/bin/python -m unittest discover packages/python/tests
scripts.python:sdk:example: python3 -m venv .venv-python && .venv-python/bin/python -m pip install -q -e packages/python && PYTHONPATH=packages/python .venv-python/bin/python examples/python-client/main.py
scripts.python:sdk:pack: python3 -m venv .venv-python && .venv-python/bin/python -m pip install -q build && rm -rf tmp/python-dist && .venv-python/bin/python -m build packages/python --wheel --outdir tmp/python-dist
scripts.smoke:imports: bun --eval 'await import("@hrbr/client"); await import("@hrbr/client/effect"); await import("@hrbr/sdk"); await import("@hrbr/sdk/core/trigger"); await import("@hrbr/sdk/platform/local")'
scripts.smoke: bun run typecheck && bun run smoke:imports && bun run --filter client-promise-example start && bun run --filter sdk-system-example start && bun run --filter local-platform-example start && bun run python:sdk:test && bun run python:sdk:example
scripts.pack:dry-run: npm pack --dry-run ./packages/client && npm pack --dry-run ./packages/sdk && bun run python:sdk:pack
